value.answer: Depends whether you're putting down under 20% or not. Lowest insured 5-year fixed is about 4.34% right now (Ratehub, Oct 12), and lowest uninsured is about 4.44% (WOWA, Oct 9). The big banks are higher, averaging around 5.14%, and rates have been creeping up this month. I can't check the exact number right now, so treat those as rough as of this week.
